name: Empty Cages Collective (ECC)
aka: Empty Cages Collective (ECC) - small-animal / guinea pig program
neighborhoods: Williamsburg-based (11211); serves NYC + Hudson Valley via fosters
notes:
All-volunteer 501(c)(3) animal + environmental advocacy rescue. Feral-cat TNR + rescue/adoption; pulls cats from NYCACC; FeLV+ and special-needs cat specialty; also dogs/rabbits/small animals/wildlife. Brooklyn (Williamsburg) base with citywide + Hudson Valley reach. Verified 2026-08-26. Intake: Adoption application (PDF) via adopt@ email Intake: FaceTime interview + home drop-off

All-volunteer 501(c)(3). Adopts guinea pigs only in pairs or to homes that already have one (they are social herd animals). Adoption donation from $30 single / $50 pair; $150 if spayed/neutered. Also a cat rescue (listed in the NYC cat reference). Intake: application via adopt@emptycagescollective.org
